qs.q: Match the messages (1–5) and statements (A–F). There is one letter you do not need.
items: 1  I got stuck in the traffic so I’m going to be a bit late. Don’t leave without me.
2  The talk show starts at 8. I’ll wait for you at the entrance to the studio. Don’t forget that once the cameras are on, you can’t enter.
3  I’ve got the chance to study abroad, but I’d have to leave my job here. What should I do? I need an answer soon.
4  I apologize. I was rude and selfish, but I really care about you. Please let me prove it to you.
5  Sorry I had to run off, but our discussion is not over. I want to tell you what I think.
rights: C — Text me before you leave.
D — I’ll talk to you later.
F — Tell me what you think.
